synthesis:draft.headline: TAS1 five-minute dispatch price peaked at $450.08/MWh at 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000); the spike was confined to a single five-minute interval at or above $300/MWh.
summary: Peak five-minute dispatch price (RRP) in TAS1: $450.08/MWh at 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000) (evidence: ev0434).
Number of five-minute intervals at or above the $300/MWh analysis threshold in the window: 1 interval (evidence: ev0003; threshold evidence: ev0004).
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the peak 5-minute interval (interval ending 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000)): 1105.32 MW (dispatch TOTALDEMAND, evidence: ev0435).
Operational (half-hour) demand in the half-hour containing the price extreme (half-hour ending 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000)): 1147.0 MW (evidence: ev0897).
Window maximum operational demand (half-hour): 1408.0 MW (evidence: ev0909).
No AEMO market notice was held for TAS1 in the searched region/window (retrieve_public_evidence search_scope indicated no notice held for this region and window).

possible_explanations.statement: A sudden reduction in output from one or more Tasmanian generators may be related to the price spike (see generation-change entries such as REECE, TVCCPS, CETHANA) [generation-change evidence].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check unit-level SCADA and outage/availability reports around 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (the interval end reported by the price timeline, e.g. 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000)).

possible_explanations.statement: A change in net interconnector flow magnitude or an interconnector constraint might be related; the price timeline records net interconnector flow at the peak interval (see netinterchange at peak).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check Basslink flow, any interconnector constraint notices and dispatch constraint records for 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000)).

possible_explanations.statement: Weather-related changes to wind availability could be relevant; Hobart-point WS50M wind-speed context is available.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare measured wind farm outputs and WS50M wind-speed observations for the hours around 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z to see if a drop in wind generation aligns with the spike.
